name: Bashal'Aran
summary: At Bashal'Aran, Asterion's spirit remains bound by an ancient seal. You carry the seal south to Ameth'Aran, where an old flame may break his bonds.

sections.title: A Prison of Ancient Sorcery
sections.body: Asterion's spirit remains chained in death at Bashal'Aran by an Ancient Moonstone Seal. Highborne sorcerers forged it before the Great Sundering, and no ordinary strength can break its power. Only an ancient flame still burning among Ameth'Aran's fallen stones to the south can destroy it.

sections.title: Twin Ruins of Darkshore
sections.body: Bashal'Aran and Ameth'Aran were sister settlements of the kaldorei under Queen Azshara, when the Well of Eternity anchored their empire. Now both are overgrown, haunted ruins, where ghosts linger and arcane power remains volatile. In a stone gazebo at Ameth'Aran, a mystical brazier burns with cyan fire. Only this flame can consume Asterion's binding relic.

sections.title: Vengeance Awakens
sections.body: Asterion is free once the seal is destroyed, and sees a shattered Kalimdor far changed from the golden age he remembers. Yet freedom brings no peace. He senses that Athrikus, his former Highborne master and jailor, still endures. Despair turns to a cold hunger for revenge.

faq.answer: Asterion is a night elf spirit trapped in Bashal'Aran's ruins. He dates back ten thousand years, to Queen Azshara's reign, and a seal forged by one of the most powerful Highborne binds him there.

faq.q: Where do I destroy the Ancient Moonstone Seal?
faq.answer: Carry the Ancient Moonstone Seal south to Ameth'Aran, Bashal'Aran's twin ruin. In a stone gazebo, a large cubical brazier burns with ancient greenish-blue fire that can destroy it.

faq.q: What is the relationship between Bashal'Aran and Ameth'Aran?
faq.answer: Bashal'Aran and Ameth'Aran were sister cities in the ancient night elf empire before the Sundering. Both were devastated ten thousand years ago, leaving haunted stone pillars, lingering arcane power, and restless spirits.
Asterion says one of the most powerful Highborne made the seal that binds him. His former master is revealed as the story continues.
Asterion remembers the age when the original Well of Eternity still existed, Queen Azshara ruled the empire, and Highborne nobles held their majestic courts before the Sundering.

faq.q: Does freeing Asterion lay his spirit to rest?
faq.answer: Destroying the seal is meant to break Asterion's prison. What freedom means to him becomes clear when you return.

angles.text: As a night elf of modern Kalimdor, you meet your people's pre-Sundering past and the lingering corruption of Queen Azshara's Highborne nobility when Asterion is freed.
As a mage, you glimpse the raw arcane power of ancient Highborne sorcerers in the enchantments binding Asterion and the flames that endure at Ameth'Aran.
As an Alliance member, you help clear ancient curses in Darkshore and secure the borders for new night elf settlements expanding from Auberdine.
